model_annotation: The two line graphs display the relationship between the variable BLEU and two different parameters, α and ρ, respectively. Both graphs share the same y-axis, labeled "BLEU," which is scaled linearly from 28.0 to 28.5 in increments of 0.1. The left graph plots BLEU against α, with the x-axis ranging from 0.1 to 0.9 in increments of 0.2. The data is represented by a blue line with circular markers, showing a peak BLEU value of 28.5 at α = 0.5, with values decreasing to 28.1 at α = 0.9 and 28.3 at α = 0.3. The right graph plots BLEU against ρ, with the x-axis ranging from 0.05 to 0.45 in increments of 0.15. This graph also uses a blue line with circular markers, showing a peak BLEU value of 28.5 at ρ = 0.15, with values decreasing to 28.4 at ρ = 0.25 and 28.4 at ρ = 0.45.
